requirements.requirement: Serial, two local-parallel, and two genuine independent-runner shard conditions
One exact execution inventory across every compared condition
Independent PostgreSQL and browser runners for each distributed shard
Retained raw JSONL, CSV, machine summary, and Markdown summary evidence
Median, range, IQR, MAD, speedup, and parallel-efficiency calculations
requirements.actualResult: Statistics and ratio guards are verified; actual cross-condition speedups are withheld because runner hardware differs.

requirements.requirement: Separate setup, execution, merge, elapsed wall, and aggregate runner timing
requirements.actualResult: Setup, shard execution, merge, queue-inclusive wall and instrumented runner totals are retained. Readiness, in-process reporting and shutdown inside a shard are not separately profiled.

requirements.requirement: One-to-five bounded measured repetitions with five required for release evidence
Focused regression coverage for statistics, inventories, manifests, and workflow trust boundaries
requirements.actualResult: 22 benchmark regression tests passed locally and in the exact-source hosted verification matrix.
Five repetitions in each of five conditions passed execution, inventory, evidence and supplementary gates. This is not controlled-hardware performance acceptance.

statusSemantics.PASS: Verified by exact-source automated evidence already recorded in the repository.
statusSemantics.IMPLEMENTED: Executable implementation and regression coverage exist but the hosted benchmark has not yet established a measured result.
statusSemantics.NOT_RUN: The named measurement or hosted acceptance has not been executed and is not represented as complete.
statusSemantics.PARTIAL: The recorded execution evidence is valid but the named profiling or performance requirement has an explicit remaining limitation.
